say:1:1720731001:0.text: Thank you for your generosity, young lady! This coin reflects your appreciation of my talent—and will buy me a fine drink!
say:1:1720731001:0.source_cn: 哈！感谢您的慷慨，年轻的小姐。这一枚金币，不仅能买酒暖...

say:2:1720731002:1.text: Are you sure... you don't need anything else?
say:2:1720731002:1.source_cn: 除了这枚金币外，您真的不需要……更多的帮助吗？

say:3:1720731003:1.text: I appreciate your kindness, but I wouldn't call this suffering.
say:3:1720731003:1.source_cn: 这位小姐，你的好意我心领了，可是我并不觉得我有什么困境啊。

say:4:1720731004:0.text: An empty stomach only helps me sing of hunger more movingly. As long as I have my lute and even one listener, I am the happiest, richest man in the world!
say:4:1720731004:0.source_cn: 今天的饿肚子，只是为了明天能唱出更动人的饥饿感。只要琴...

say:5:1720731005:0.text: And I believe my voice will reach a wider audience one day!
say:5:1720731005:0.source_cn: 琴弦不断，歌声不停，就一定会有好事发生。总有一天，我的...

say:6:1720731006:0.text: I'm sure you can do it! Your voice deserves a bigger stage!
say:6:1720731006:0.source_cn: 一定会到来的！您的歌声值得更大的舞台！

say:7:1720731007:0.text: Thanks for your encouragement! Today's setback is just a stepping stone to my future success! Hahaha!
say:7:1720731007:0.source_cn: 借您吉言！为了那一天，今天的这点挫折，不过是未来传奇故...
